questions.question: According to the letter to the Hebrews, faith is the certainty of what we can already see. True or false?
When Noah was warned about things not yet seen, what did he build in godly fear?

answers.text: An ark to save his family
A city named for his son
A tower to reach the sky

questions.question: When God called Abraham to go to a new place, he obeyed and went even though he did not know where he was going. True or false?
Sarah was barren and beyond the proper age, yet she was able to conceive a child. What was behind it?

answers.text: She considered God faithful to His promise
She asked a prophet to pray for her
She waited for a sign from heaven
